# resume
tabla_resumen <- home %>%
  group_by(event_type) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Edad_media = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Edad_sd = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Charlson_mediana = median(charlson, na.rm = TRUE),
    Charlson_IQR = IQR(charlson, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_Polimed = sum(polimed == "Si", na.rm = TRUE) / n() * 100,
    Pct_Hombre = sum(sex == "Hombre", na.rm = TRUE) / n() * 100
  )

print(tabla_resumen)
```

dat <- home %>%

    outcome = case_when(
      delta == 0 ~ "Censored",
      delta == 1 ~ "Reinfection",
      delta == 2 ~ "Death"
    ),
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("Censored", "Reinfection", "Death"))
  )
```

dat %>%

  pivot_longer(cols = -stime0,

# Competing risk

```{r}
library(cmprsk)
# Incidencia acumulada básica
ci_result <- with(home, cuminc(stime0, delta))

# Ver resultados con más detalle (10 puntos temporales, 2 decimales)
print(ci_result, ntp = 10, digits = 2)

# Análisis de incidencia acumulada
with(home, cuminc(stime0, delta))

# Imprimir con más detalle
with(home, print(cuminc(stime0, delta), ntp = 10, digits = 2))

# Gráfico mejorado con personalización
with(home, {
  ci <- cuminc(stime0, delta)
  ci2 <- ci[grep("1 1", names(ci))] # Survival curve

  plot(ci2, 
       ylim = c(0, 0.5),
       yaxt = "n",  
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence",
       main = "CIF for reinfection ",
       col =  "red", 
       curvlab="reinfection of home",# Colores para reinfección y muerte
       lwd = 2
  )
  
  axis(2, at = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.05), las = 1)
  
  # Añadir grid para mejor lectura
  grid(nx = NULL, ny = NULL, lty = 2, col = "gray90")
})
```

```{r,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
library(cmprsk)

# ============================================================
# 1. ESTRATIFICADO POR PERÍODO home
# ============================================================

# Crear objeto de incidencia acumulada FUERA del with()
ci_period <- with(home, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = period))

# Ahora sí puedes graficar dentro del with()
with(home, {
  ci_period_re <- ci_period[grep("1$", names(ci_period))]
  
  plot(ci_period_re, 
       ylim = c(0, 0.6),
       color = c(1, 2, 3),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1),
       curvlab=c("period1", "period2", "period3"),
       lwd = 3, 
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by home Period")
})

# ============================================================
# 2. Stratified for CHARLSON INDEX 
# ============================================================

home$charlson_cat <- cut(home$charlson,
                          breaks = c(-1, 0, 2, 5, 20),
                          labels = c("0", "1-2", "3-5", ">5"))

# CREAR FUERA
ci_charlson <- with(home, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = charlson_cat))

# GRAFICAR DENTRO
with(home, {
  ci_charlson_re <- ci_charlson[grep("1$", names(ci_charlson))]
  
  plot(ci_charlson_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.6),
       color = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       curvlab=c("0","1-2","3-5",">5"),
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Charlson Comorbidity Index")
})

# ============================================================
# 3. QUINTIL
# ============================================================

ci_quintil <- with(home, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = quintil))

with(home, {
  ci_quintil_re <- ci_quintil[grep("1$", names(ci_quintil))]
  
  plot(ci_quintil_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.4),
       color = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       curvlab=c("1","2","3","4","5"),
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Socioeconomic Quintile")
})

# ============================================================
# 4. POLYMADICATION
# ============================================================

ci_polimed <- with(home, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = polimed))

with(home, {
  ci_polimed_re <- ci_polimed[grep("1$", names(ci_polimed))]
  
  plot(ci_polimed_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.5),
       color = c(1, 2),   
       lty = c(1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       curvlab=c("Polymadication: No", "Polymadication: Yes"),
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Polymedication Status")
})

ci_polimed <- with(home, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = polimed))

with(home, {
  # Extract the reinfection curves (ending in "1")
  ci_re <- ci_polimed[grep("1$", names(ci_polimed))]
  
  # Pull estimates, variances and time for each group
  t0  <- ci_re[[1]]$time;  e0 <- ci_re[[1]]$est;  v0 <- ci_re[[1]]$var
  t1  <- ci_re[[2]]$time;  e1 <- ci_re[[2]]$est;  v1 <- ci_re[[2]]$var
  
  # 95% CI bounds
  lo0 <- pmax(0, e0 - 1.96*sqrt(v0));  hi0 <- e0 + 1.96*sqrt(v0)
  lo1 <- pmax(0, e1 - 1.96*sqrt(v1));  hi1 <- e1 + 1.96*sqrt(v1)
  
  # Base plot
  plot(ci_polimed[grep("1$", names(ci_polimed))],
       ylim    = c(0, 0.5),
       color   = c("steelblue", "firebrick"),
       lty     = c(1, 1),
       lwd     = 3,
       cex     = 1.2,
       xlab    = "Days from day 120",
       ylab    = "Cumulative Incidence",
       curvlab = c("Polymedication: No", "Polymedication: Yes"))
  
  title(main = "CIF for Reinfection by Polymedication Status")
  
  # CI bands
  polygon(c(t0, rev(t0)), c(hi0, rev(lo0)), col = adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.15), border = NA)
  polygon(c(t1, rev(t1)), c(hi1, rev(lo1)), col = adjustcolor("firebrick", 0.15), border = NA)
  
  # Overlap region — interpolate both CIs onto a common time grid
  tgrid   <- sort(unique(c(t0, t1)))
  lo0_i   <- approx(t0, lo0, tgrid, rule = 2)$y
  hi0_i   <- approx(t0, hi0, tgrid, rule = 2)$y
  lo1_i   <- approx(t1, lo1, tgrid, rule = 2)$y
  hi1_i   <- approx(t1, hi1, tgrid, rule = 2)$y
  
  overlap_lo <- pmax(lo0_i, lo1_i)
  overlap_hi <- pmin(hi0_i, hi1_i)
  overlap    <- overlap_hi > overlap_lo          # where bands actually cross
})

# ============================================================
# 6. SEX
# ============================================================

ci_sex <- with(home, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = sex))

with(home, {
  cmpsex <- ci_sex[grep("1$", names(ci_sex))]
  
  par(las = 1, font = 2, font.lab = 2, font.axis = 2)
  plot(cmpsex,
       ylim = c(0, 0.5),
       color = c(1, 2),
       lty = c(1, 1),
       curvlab = c("Female: Reinfection", "Male: Reinfection"),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Sex")
})

ci_sex <- with(home, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = sex))
with(home, {
  # Extract the reinfection curves (ending in "1")
  ci_se <- ci_sex[grep("1$", names(ci_sex))]
  
  # Pull estimates, variances and time for each group
  t0  <- ci_se[[1]]$time;  e0 <- ci_se[[1]]$est;  v0 <- ci_se[[1]]$var
  t1  <- ci_se[[2]]$time;  e1 <- ci_se[[2]]$est;  v1 <- ci_se[[2]]$var
  
  # 95% CI bounds
  lo0 <- pmax(0, e0 - 1.96*sqrt(v0));  hi0 <- e0 + 1.96*sqrt(v0)
  lo1 <- pmax(0, e1 - 1.96*sqrt(v1));  hi1 <- e1 + 1.96*sqrt(v1)
  
  # Base plot
  plot(ci_sex[grep("1$", names(ci_sex))],
       ylim    = c(0, 0.5),
       color   = c("steelblue", "firebrick"),
       lty     = c(1, 1),
       lwd     = 3,
       cex     = 1.2,
       xlab    = "Days from day 120",
       ylab    = "Cumulative Incidence",
       curvlab = c("female", "male"))
  
  title(main = "CIF for Reinfection by Polymedication Status")
  
  # CI bands
  polygon(c(t0, rev(t0)), c(hi0, rev(lo0)), col = adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.15), border = NA)
  polygon(c(t1, rev(t1)), c(hi1, rev(lo1)), col = adjustcolor("firebrick", 0.15), border = NA)
  
  # Overlap region — interpolate both CIs onto a common time grid
  tgrid   <- sort(unique(c(t0, t1)))
  lo0_i   <- approx(t0, lo0, tgrid, rule = 2)$y
  hi0_i   <- approx(t0, hi0, tgrid, rule = 2)$y
  lo1_i   <- approx(t1, lo1, tgrid, rule = 2)$y
  hi1_i   <- approx(t1, hi1, tgrid, rule = 2)$y
  
  overlap_lo <- pmax(lo0_i, lo1_i)
  overlap_hi <- pmin(hi0_i, hi1_i)
  overlap    <- overlap_hi > overlap_lo          # where bands actually cross
})
# ============================================================
# 8. RESUME
# ============================================================

cat("\n=== SUMMARY OF GRAY'S TESTS ===\n\n")

cat("PERIOD:\n")
print(ci_period$Tests)
cat("\n")

cat("CHARLSON:\n")
print(ci_charlson$Tests)
cat("\n")

cat("QUINTILE:\n")
print(ci_quintil$Tests)
cat("\n")

cat("POLYMEDICATION:\n")
print(ci_polimed$Tests)
cat("\n")

cat("SEX:\n")
print(ci_sex$Tests)
cat("\n")

```


```{r}
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(survival)

# Cox model for reinfection (event = 1)
causmod1 <- coxph(Surv(stime0, delta == 1) ~ sex + age + charlson + quintil+polimed,
                  data = home)

# Extract results
resultados <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = FALSE)

# Create custom table
tabla_cox <- data.frame(
  Variable = resultados$term,
  Beta = round(resultados$estimate, 3),
  SE = round(resultados$std.error, 3),
  CI_lower = round(resultados$conf.low, 3),
  CI_upper = round(resultados$conf.high, 3),
  Z_stat = round(resultados$statistic, 2),
  p_value = ifelse(resultados$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                   round(resultados$p.value, 3))
)

# Display table
kable(tabla_cox, 
      caption = "Cox Model for home-19 Reinfection",
      align = c('l', rep('c', 6)),
      col.names = c("Variable", "Est.", "SE", "CI Low", "CI Up", "Z", "p"),
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"),
                position = "center",
                font_size = 9,
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "2cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:7, width = "1.5cm") %>%
  footnote(general = paste("n =", causmod1$n, 
                          "; Events =", causmod1$nevent,
                          "; C-index =", round(summary(causmod1)$concordance[1], 2)),
           threeparttable = TRUE)
```
